notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.2 - Autosave's Here!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/a881187431fd02ba9242aae6e20f13a4a4136305.png"]


Patch Notes


☀️ Fixes & Improvements Based on Community Feedback


Bugfixes:
☀️ Fixed an issue where the game would consume excessive memory and freeze when paused and left running for an extended period.

☀️ Fixed a bug where quickly placing a launchpad while moving the mouse could cause the placement to fail while still subtracting tech points and credits. This could lead to softlocks and occurred more frequently on lower-FPS PCs and Steam Deck.

☀️ Sector 03.1: Fixed ceramic not displaying a recipe in the wiki when playing this sector before Sector 04.

☀️ Fixed audio clips cutting off prematurely when fast-forwarding game speed.

☀️ Fixed custom key rebinds only initializing after opening the rebinding screen instead of loading automatically.

Fixed the rebind button not reverting to its default label when starting a different rebind process, which effectively canceled the current one.

☀️ Added a stick deadzone to prevent drifting on connected gamepads, which caused the asteroid to keep rotating.

☀️ Fixed the "Edge Rotation Enabled" setting reverting to its default value after restarting the game.
Achievements:
☀️ Added a progress bar for most achievements — either counting down (e.g., for the Space Falcon challenge) or counting up.

☀️ Disabled "Achievement Missed" notifications if the achievement has already been unlocked.

Added a “missed” visual state (semi-transparent) to achievement badges.

☀️ Sector 05: Improved consistency of Hard Melting remaining ice area calculation. (Note: Ice can still spawn under craters, preventing the achievement from triggering — check the progress bar to confirm.)
Other Improvements:
☀️ Implemented autosave at fixed intervals: the game now saves automatically when switching scenes if 3 minutes have passed, and after 6 minutes if staying in the same scene. This can be disabled in the settings menu.

☀️ Added descriptions to most resource and building wiki entries.

☀️ Improved performance when drawing very long rover paths.

☀️ When syncing game data with Steam Cloud, the game no longer considers it a first launch on a new PC (which would play the prologue cutscene and restart Level 01) if save data already exists.

☀️ Sector 01: Stats screen and score tooltip are now accessible before completing the sector.

Sector 01: The Intro cutscene no longer plays every time  when restarting the sector after completing it once.

Sector 05: Removed inaccessible small craters from plateaus to avoid confusion.

☀️ Rover no longer moves while the game is paused.

☀️ Added a game resolution setting to the cutscene skip menu.

☀️ When a Strangelet is excavated (last excavation quest fulfilled), it now disappears from the asteroid and the excavation hub performing the excavation is destroyed, making it clear that the hub is no longer active.

Pause the cutscene playback while the cutscene skip menu is open.

Added social buttons to the credits screen for kurzgesagt’s Bluesky and TikTok profiles.





The best place to give feedback is our Discord server. There, we are running a Smart Ticketing System: Leave feedback, vote up change requests and bug reports from other users, and help us to prioritize tasks in the further development of Star Birds. 



 🙏Thank you so much everyone for the overwhelming response, all your feedback, comments and bug reports! This helps us a lot to prioritize and identify issues with the game. We're trying to address the most critical issues as soon as we can. Please be patient though, since we're a small team and might take a while to address specific issues you're experiencing!🙏

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.1 - For Tutorial Beginners & Highscore Hunters
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/6f93745bc524153c6b952602c302f9065290c214.png"]


Patch Notes


☀️ Fixes & Improvements Based on Community Feedback



Bugfixes:

☀️ Sector 01: Fixed last tutorial step not triggering (outro dialogue not starting) when connecting the refiner to a launch pad before connecting it to a water extractor

☀️ Sector 03: Acid recipe now unlocks by default at the start of Level 03 to prevent module quests from stopping at station level 13 when level 14 is required for the Logistics achievement.

☀️ Sector 05.1: Fixed High Score 05.1 condition incorrectly rewarding the Star Bird 05.1 achievement, which made High Score 05.1 unobtainable.

☀️ Enter and Discover asteroid tooltips no longer render in front of the in-game menu, dialogues, or other UI elements.

☀️ Hovering over buildings is no longer detected when the building is obscured by UI (e.g. bug reporting or in-game menu screens).

☀️ Fixed music track skipping when alt + tabbing out of game while Run In Background is disabled.

☀️ Fixed an issue where deleting a Receiver sometimes caused two interplanetary connection lines to be drawn on top of each other, making it seem like one was missing.

Flying coin particles no longer freeze when opening the in-game menu.



Improvements:

☀️ Sector 04: Added an additional trigger to unblock ice extractor research. Previously, it only became available after starting the first Strangelet excavation quest. It now also becomes researchable when starting any quest that requests water, methane or acid.

Sector 04: The last excavation quest now grants +1 Strangelet, and there is a separate goal quest that rewards victory for obtaining 1 Strangelet.

☀️ Sector 07: Hid the recipe requiring conductor & feather to make thread so players focus on the simpler feather-in-refiner recipe instead.

Added tooltip to Edge Rotation Enabled setting in controls tab to make it clearer what it does: disabling the auto rotation of an asteroid while drawing paths or placing buildings (tooltip only in English and German for now).

☀️ Fixed some typos in German translation.

Version number now displays with a "v" prefix instead of "Version."

Improved tooltip positioning in the in-game menu.

Removed debug frame rates from the target frame rate dropdown.

Added a small delay before the loading screen disappears when starting a game from the menu to prevent the menu flashing for a frame before the game begins.

notes.title: Over 200k Demo Players – Thank You & Final Chance to Play!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/8d92cee087fc839a78ebeb065ffa39e86aadf403.jpg"]Thank You for an Incredible Demo Run!
Thanks to your great feedback, we have agreed to keep the demo available for the past 2 months even after the Steam Next Fest ended. We’ve noticed that many of you are still playing the demo every day and that makes us very happy! Here are some of the highlights to round up the Alpha (pre Early Access) demo run:

Over 200,000 people played the demo on Steam!

You left nearly 1,500 reviews with an 95% "Overwhelmingly Positive" rating.  

Most importantly: your feedback has been invaluable, and we’ve already implemented changes for the Early Access release on September 10th.

Most of you wishlisted the game! If you do not want to miss out on our release benefits for next week, make sure to add Star Birds to your wishlist!


One Last Weekend to Play the Demo
That said, the demo has now become quite outdated compared to the current build of the game. To make sure the Early Access release shines as it should, we have decided to allocate all of our resources during the past weeks towards improving the main game, rather than updating the demo.

This means we'll be disabling the demo from the Steam Store after this weekend. You can still enjoy the demo until Monday, September 8th, 10:00 AM CEST.

Community feedback is essential for a small indie studio like us. From balancing adjustments and quality of life improvements to your feature requests, we've taken your input seriously and incorporated it into our ongoing development of Star Birds.

One major advantage of Early Access, which we were already able to put to good use with Dorfromantik, is that we can evaluate your feedback during the game's production and incorporate it into the ongoing development. We therefore always welcome constructive feedback in the Community Hub or on our social media channels. Thank you!

If you’d like to dive deeper into how player feedback shaped the Early Access version, check out our detailed post here:

notes.title: Evasive Maneuver: EA Release moved to September 10th
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/d360c661324d94ed3674827341cd233e0fc6632f.png"]
Star Birds Early Access launches September 10th 🚀🐦
The flock is almost ready for takeoff! After months of building, tweaking, polishing, and planning, we’re thrilled to say that Star Birds will launch into Early Access very soon.
To make sure the journey starts smoothly, we’re adjusting our flight plan just a little: instead of September 4th, the launch will now be on September 10th, 2025.


Why the change?
Last week at Gamescom we had an intense but wonderful time with there was a HUGE surprise announement: Team Cherry announced the release date for the long-awaited Silksong, and we don’t want to collide beak-on with such a massive hype-supernova. Both games deserve their moment to shine and we wish Team Cherry an amzing success!
 
And honestly, we’re super excited to play Silksong ourselves, too! 🎮✨


These past weeks have been and are still incredibly exciting (and a little hectic) for our team, as we’re juggling lots of things behind the scenes and quickly reworking our release plans. Your feedback and suggestions really helped us make this call, so thank you for your passion, patience, and support - it means the world to us. 💜

We can’t wait to finally share the Early Access version of Star Birds with you on September 10th!

notes.title: Star Birds: Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
The Star Birds Demo is out now. Play Star Birds today and join us during Steam Next Fest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/61b1d3ba95919afc3991dc9d1aa7fc0ff132ea9c.png

The Star Birds Demo is waiting for you. After internal playtests in Q1, we are now looking for your feedback. As we are a small indie dev team of 8 people, we are only launching on one platform for the time being. If there is demand from the community, further ports will follow after the official release.

👉 Platform: Windows
💻 Device: PC 
🗨 Languages: Demo Available in 12 Languages
🕖 Scope: Tutorial 1, Tutorial 2, Expedition Level

Get a feel for whether Star Birds could be the right game for you. And if so, look forward to more content later this year.

Demo Scope: What to Expect


The official Star Birds demo gives you a sneak-peek into the gameplay and campaign that awaits you in the Early Access release of the game launching later this year.
It features the first two campaign levels, and infinitely replayable and procedurally generated bonus Expedition Level where you can hone and further develop your sklills on your own.
By playing this level you'll get a glimpse of more content and complexity awaiting you in the release version.

As an indie team we see the demo as a great chance to receive first hand player feedback from you!
We want to develop Star Birds closely with the community and welcome your messages, feedback and bug reports here in the Steam Community Hub or in our Discord.
Now it’s your turn, we hope you enjoy!

💁‍♀️ Included in the Demo (June 2025):

 Central Game Loop - Build production facilities and mine resources.
 Establish Production Chains - Optimize your space factory and set up interplanetary transportation lines.
 Meet the Crew - Jump into the Star Birds story campaign and go on an adventure with the birbs.
 Gameplay Tutorial - New to the factory building genre? We've got you. The Demo can be played by experienced players and curious beginners alike.
 Challenge Level - to test your acquired space mining skills and compare to other players.


🙅‍♂️ Not Included in the Demo:

 Full Story Experience - The Demo will include the beginning of the story campaign, many more mysteries await you in the full version.
 Perfectly Fine-Tuned Balancing - We need your Demo feedback, to fine-tune and optimize the game 
 Heaps of Resources and Buildings - The Demo provides a selection of ressources and buildings relevant to the scope of the Demo Sneak-peek.
 Bigger & Late-Game Challenges - Looking for more exciting missions and gameplay challenges? Find it in the final version of the game!

The Demo is available for PC in 12 languages. Download it here on Steam. The best place to give feedback is our Discord server. There, we are running a smart ticketing system: Leave feedback, vote up change requests and bug reports from other users, and help us to prioritize tasks in the further development process of Star Birds.

notes.title: Devlog: Crew Love Is True Love
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/a820122e7ace28ec52043cc5c36278ff0e7a9291.png


Today we want to introduce you to the crew. To the birds that populate the space station in Star Birds. We show you how we came up with a strong cast of characters, and how we brought the kurzgesagt birbs to a 3D universe. And not to forget their roles on board - as we will send them on a mysterious mission ...

Getting Dressed for Space 👩‍🚀
Sure - a game called Star Birds needs spacefaring birds. Cheerful supporting characters who lead you through the story, in dialogues and campaigns. But how to recruit them? 

As a first step, we analyzed the birds that we discovered in the YouTube videos together with our project partner kurzgesagt. Their body parts, their emotions, their animations. We were looking for an elegant way to equip them for their space mission. By replacing the head feathers with accessories such as pilot's caps, and their body plumage with space suits.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
 [tr]
        [th][/th]
        [th][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/46d02d3a933b5ea92dac75f545e28f57e68af725.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/af099d52c7ad691d4baa164d5ef94d685f2de38a.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Modular Bird Generation 🦉
The next challenge was to send the 2D YouTube birds to a universe where they will become the main act of various dialogue scenes and the quest givers for the delivery missions. To do so, our teams (Toukana🤝kurzgesagt) had to create a skeleton that could be animated in our game. In Blender, we converted the SVG Vector graphics into flat mesh shapes, attached them to the skeleton and a rig and now ... they're alive! 

Finally, we added gradients and a splash of color in Unity. It was important for us to think about variation of the birds in a modular way. Easily swapping body types, shapes and colors. Internally, we call our tool the "2D Bird Generator".


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/e4bfd1ccb37fd301d397ed5cf706e25be61d1d7e.png

Creating Interesting Characters 🐔
As you will not control and play your own bird character in Star Birds, but take on a managing role, our teams had to double down on the birds supporting the gameplay and narrative, leading you through the story. One of the most difficult questions was where in the game we wanted the kurzgesagt birds to appear, and where the gameplay should stand on its own.

To make the gameplay and narrative fit together, we imagined them as main charaters of the cutscenes and dialogues, operators of the buildings and machinery and quest givers. To make them interesting characters, we gave them specific professions as Scientists or Engineers, Workers, and of course last but not least - a Captain to keep every member of the crew focused on the mission... in theory ;)

You can look forward to seeing the result in Star Birds soon and meeting the bird crew! Fully clothed and commissioned. 🚀

notes.title: Star Birds Demo Lands This June!
notes.content:
Star Birds will be available as a public demo. Playable for everyone from June 2025. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/f66c0bc5db583d375527ee7904f012257d64a053.png

We are going to release a demo for Star Birds! After internal playtests in Q1, we are looking for your feedback. There lies a huge value in your various gaming experiences and backgrounds as Star Birds will be a game encompassing a broad genre mix:

🏭 Factory Builder
💎Mining & Resource Management
👽 Mysterious Story Campaign
😍 Relaxing & Fun Gameplay

We're on a mission to find the perfect balance.
Between easy-to-pick-up fun and rich, rewarding depth. Between laid-back sessions and immersive complex production network mastery.
This demo is just the beginning, as the game will launch into Early Access sometime this year.

Get ready to explore, experiment, and enjoy the ride.


This demo is designed to give you a first glimpse of the game's core experience. It's a chance to explore the gameplay, get a feel for the game flow and design, and dive into the heart of the adventure. We're looking forward to your feedback!

To keep things clear, here’s what’s ready for you now—and what’s still on the way.

💁‍♀️ Included in the Demo (June 2025):

 Central Game Loop - Build production facilities and mine resources
 Establish Production Chains - Optimize your space factory and set up interplanetary transportation lines
 Meet the Crew - Jump into the Star Birds story and go on an adventure with the birbs
 Gameplay Tutorial - New to the factory building genre? We've got you. The demo can be played by experienced players and curious beginners alike.
 Challenge level - to test your acquired space mining skills and compare to other players

🙅‍♂️ Not Included in the Demo:

 Full Story Experience - The demo will just include the beginning of the story campaign, many more mysteries await you in the full version
 Fine-Tuned Balancing - For this we need your demo feedback, there are certainly still points to optimize in the system
 Full Content of Resources and Buildings - We will provide a selection that is relevant to the scope of the demo run
 Bigger & Late-game Challenges - Looking for a higher level of difficulty and a mission beyond tutorial stage? Find it in the final version of the game!


The demo will be available for PC in 12 languages. Downloadable here on Steam. 

The best place for your feedback is our Discord server. On Discord, we will activate an upvoting tool in June that will forward your most urgent feedback directly to the dev team. 🙌

notes.title: Devlog: Resources in Star Birds
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/ee3271487e1da04803a5e3a028584662cd770365.png

Today, we're excited to unveil the first hint of cosmic bounty the solar system in Star Birds has to offer! We've cooked up our own unique "ingredient list" for the universe, packed with both familiar and fantastical resources, all wrapped in a vibrant, clean design to make gathering materials a blast.

Cosmic Cookbook - Our Recipe for Resources 🚀
If you've ever enjoyed tinkering with building blocks, mixing potions or finding interesting item combinations, you'd have loved our initial resource brainstorm! We started with the plausible basics you'd expect to find on asteroids and in space. Then, we let our imaginations run wild, adding some truly unique "spice" to the mix. We experimented with wild combos, figuring out what awesome new materials your Star Bird colony could whip up. 

The result? A sprawling catalog of metals, gases, and even some completely made-up substances, all waiting to be discovered on asteroid surfaces and transformed into essential goodies for your thriving intergalactic bird colony.

    [/tr]
[/table]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/5b3350eb8fe338e08380813f6b15444d0ab4f24b.png

When Water Forms a Drop 💧
The elements needed a gestalt. We wanted to combine the flat, colorful design of kurzgesagt with the 3D look of Toukana. The resource equivalent in the game includes the resource icon - its shape and color defined by the resource category (e.g. metal, gas), the resource field on the asteroid surface (as discovered by the rover unit), and the HUD layout displaying resources - for a clear and easily readable gaming experience. Step by step, we came up with a holistic design language for the in-game resources.

Overlooking Complexity 🤓
Finally, we adjusted the complexity level. To have more efficient test runs, we developed a tool that shows us the complexity level of a specific production chain. Answering questions such as: How many steps will it take a test player to produce a certain resource? How many units of this resource have already been mined? And if this resource is mined, what options does this open up to the player?

With our Pending Complexity Tool, the focus will increasingly shift towards balancing. Our goal: The development of well-integrated production chains for a good game flow and transparent level advancement.

notes.title: Devlog: The Music of Star Birds
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/93e830c448ddc2dc6fadebaf72c4b25cedc80185.png

For Star Birds, we are now at a point where we are creating music and sound. Which recurring theme accompanies the player? What does the space factory sound like? Let us take you on an audiovisual journey of space and sound.

Tracks: Avoiding Ear Fatigue 👂
We think that music can have a big impact on the long-term playability of a game. It should be a homecoming, create an unobtrusive atmosphere, and convince with subtle beauty and variation. 

The music in Star Birds is supposed to have a distinct character and welcome players to a familiar "universe" at every launch. Even after many hours, we need to avoid ear fatigue. It’s the smooth transitions and soft changes in dynamics which build a foundation for the game-feel and mood.

[table noborder=1]
 [tr]
        [th][/th]
        [th][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/e8bd4ea17430a23e7af51af85c5b2b9c6230306d.gif[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/f3fd1f7837b35d9feb99b8b75044c97686fdeb13.gif[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Sounds: In Space, Noone Can Hear You ... Build? 🔨
For us, sounds fulfill at least three functions in the game: First and foremost, sounds define the atmosphere and style of a game. Second, they give feedback or confirmation for successful player actions (e.g. hovering over a button, placing a building or plugging in pipes). And finally, sounds are crucial as alert signals - warning players or helping them react to events. They are supporting visual cues.

notes.title: Devlog: The Star Map
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/0dc8ab7a8c2621776433157eb3076062f932f389.png


The Star Map is an important game element in Star Birds. In each System you explore, it gives you an overview over many procedurally generated 3D asteroids, which you connect with rocket transportation routes. As players you will also be switching from asteroid surface to the map view and back, which we’re aiming for to be smooth and seamless - not an easy task!

Creating a 3D Star System 🌔
When you imagine creating your own star system, you probably expect a fulminant Big Bang. Reality is that the process begins with a set of rather pragmatic questions: What color is the universe? Is our star system flat? And if not (which is more in line with our world view): Can you seamlessly zoom out from a single asteroid to the Star Map? 

In the end, we opted for 3D objects but a 2D look – in line with the game’s artstyle so far, and kurzgesagt’s video animations.

Procedurally Generated Asteroids 🌟
In a star system, there are asteroids. Plenty of asteroids. In Star Birds, we generate them procedurally by using colors, parameters, shapes and rules that we design.

As a small indie studio, we want to use our capacities for a satisfying game flow rather than for the design of thousands of intergalactic pebbles. As a team, we were keen on developing new skills, facing new challenges and fun from a game design perspective.

Interstellar Transportation Routes 🚀
By now, the rockets are flying and transporting goods from one asteroid to the other. At the moment, we are busy making sure that you will be able to keep a good overview: Distinguishing discovered from undiscovered asteroids, remembering which resources are transported on which route, and making it joyful to zoom out, lean back, and just watch the galactic goings-on from afar.

The Star Map still needs a little refinement, but a universe is not created in a single day, right?

notes.title: Devlog: Wrap Asteroids in Pipes!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/4acc6ff98b2f31c4a58545d6031343e77ba680fa.png

The Pipe Network 🍝

Star Birds is a cozy factory builder. You place buildings across an asteroid and connect them with pipes. The pipes have an iconic transparent look, and the drawing mechanic is free-handed -  just like drawing with a brush, married with the elegance of dragging a garden hose around.

Bye to the Rigid Grid: Go with the Flow 🧶 

When you develop a factory builder, one central question is: How do you get raw materials from one building to the next? At the beginning, we considered having conveyor belts. However, a rigid building grid did not feel wholesome, so we decided for flexible pipes instead. We sifted through the wonderful content library of our project partner kurzgesagt - in a nutshell to find style inspiration, and created some concept art of our vision. Smoothly moving goods, soft curves and rich, vibrant colors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/0af8109a7173bd3d7d0a65553487e203c700d33b.pngabove: early Star birds Concept Art, still using conveyor belts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/3ababa23a4ba0aaeee9a31b112c6338f3161a28f.pngabove: later Concept Art with UI Design explorations and pipes only


Transparent Pipes and Connector Designs 🔌

We decided on a transparent pipe material to clearly show the flow and direction of the pipe contents. This makes it easier for the player to navigate the overall production system. 

Ever been to a country with a different socket type than the one you are used to? Now imagine that situation in space. We neede to find a solution and prototyped different building connectors, carefully assessing their shape langauge and color, and tested feedback effects like rotating rings and flashing signal lights on the building itself. We ended up with a minimalistic connector design only on the pipe end, and a universal input-output ring on the buildings base. This makes it easy to quickly spot the connectors, grab and drag them, to ultimately connect them to a buildings IO-ring and ensure that your production network is running smoothly.

Free-Handed Pipe Dragging: Creativity Meets Strategy 🎨 

The last and most important step was to make the gameplay feel wholesome and satisfying. We developed a free-handed pipe drawing mechanic, resulting in smooth curved paths like lines drawn with a brush. It' super easy to do, and feels a bit like dragging around a garden hose. We wanted it to feel espacially satisfying to interact with the irregular 3D asteroid surfaces while constructing your creations.

notes.title: Devlog: How We Create Buildings for Star Birds
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/6648768f35edf84d44310537e6e4577a2a414d6e.png

Hey everyone,

Today we'd love to talk a little about buildings in Star Birds, as they do play an important role in the game! As one of the core aspects of the game you will spend a lot of time with, we wanted to make sure they are looking as awesome as can be, while also not being static so your asteroids actually become lively little colonies all on their own.

So, How Did We Do That?

Define the Style
Well, we started out by defining a general style for the architecture. We were attracted by old kitchen appliances, especially those from the 80s and 90s, for their specific shape language.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/1b0f9594e7a83a0f0fb513f75bac352508e5774a.png

Figure Out What Is Important
With the general looks locked in, the first step in adding a new building is to work out which elements are needed to truly make it work. For our mining drill, as an example, that meant having an actual drill, bucket-wheel-excavator, or another similar mining implement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/21b20506fcfe070a890656672ac754affd1795f3.png

Finding a Clear Design Language
From there, our next thoughts were all about how a potential upgrade path could look like, starting with a very basic version of the drill and then going to more and more extravagant and busy designs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/3880c6d016d8389b2f20a58651c6147526649845.png

Choose and Refine
In the end, we took the drill concept, and simplified it! The drill now is the dominating element of the building, both in shape and animation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/8ebdfe63413fef8faa6fc11f5b150f061b1d7c1d.png

The Result

Our final concept has the drill visibly moving up and down, spinning as if truly digging into the ground. This also allows for some very interesting movement all over an asteroid!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/3cdc24497fce70968924329b6cc45022f72ae015.gif

We hope this view behind the curtain was interesting! If you would like to see more from behind-the-scenes, sign up for our newsletter over on our Website!
